title: The Lifeguard Company LTD
description: Previously, a significant portion of the process—including the registration and recruitment of lifeguards, as well as the management of contracts with organizations—was handled manually using paper-based methods. With the lifeguard management software, this entire workflow has been fully automated. Everything from scheduling interviews and hiring lifeguards to issuing invoices and formalizing contracts with organizations is now automated; this has eliminated many manual-processing costs and accelerated operational outcomes, ultimately removing unnecessary expenses for the company.

title: PoolPal™ Corp.
description: This company specializes in the maintenance and monitoring of commercial and institutional swimming pools. This project involved the development of a comprehensive system, encompassing both administrative and customer-facing functionalities. Each section underwent independent design and implementation, ensuring a tailored and optimized user experience for both internal staff and external clients.

title: Peekage
description: This company specializes in distributing product test samples to selected customers and gathering feedback on their user experience. The software facilitates the entire process—from the distribution of test samples and the collection of user feedback (via various types of questions) to the generation of reports for manufacturers. It also supports collaboration with marketers to target specific audiences and enables two-way communication with consumers. Key features of the project include a dedicated panel for marketing users, the ability to define campaigns, and the visualization of initial feedback metrics.

title: Righcar Corp.
description: This company provides smart automotive solutions, offering, among other products, a vehicle diagnostic dongle for personal use. Managing the data and parameters transmitted by these dongles required a management panel capable of handling high volumes of information. For this project, the entire infrastructure for the panel was built from scratch. With the implementation of this system, managers and sales specialists gained visibility into the performance of the sold dongles. Additionally, a PWA version of the software and the company’s website were developed.

title: Caring Connected Car Solution
description: This company provided management solutions for corporate vehicle fleets. Its team consisted of hardware specialists, software developers, and user interface designers. As a web developer, I built tools for real-time monitoring and fleet management via a map interface; these included the display of vehicle speed, cabin temperature, real-time location, ECU status, and other relevant details.

title: Andisheh Co.
description: The company worked on security solutions for web applications. At first I worked as a front-end developer using DevExpress components for winform desktop applications. Then I started developing in C# for back-end aspects of company applications.

title: Arttem Studio
description: At this company, I designed and implemented client websites using WordPress on a part-time basis.

title: DPCO Group
description: The company's product was a supply chain and product inquiry system, in which all of the company's required processes were implemented.
